data.one_liner: Pluralize and singularize any word and check if it is singular or plural.
data.what_it_does: A utility package that lets you check whether a word is singular or plural. It can also convert words between singular and plural forms, supporting irregular and uncountable words.
use_when: You need to dynamically pluralize or singularize words in your app text.
You want to validate if a given word is singular or plural.
avoid_when: You require complex, multi-language localization rules beyond English pluralization adaptations.
You need extensive test coverage for every edge case of irregular words.
strengths: Simple API with clear methods like plural, singular, isSingular, and isPlural.
weaknesses: Tests do not cover all possible cases.
May not support all irregular and uncountable words out of the box.
